name: Professor Ved
description: The channel's explainer, drawn in clean flat-vector style (no outlines, two-tone shading). 25, handsome, athletic: broad shoulders, slim waist. Black hair swept up into a quiff with a skin fade. Crisp full black beard following a slightly narrow jaw, plus a distinct full moustache; they meet only at the mouth corners with a clean skin gap right below the lower lip. No glasses. White shirt, top button open, sleeves folded below the elbow; black trousers, black belt, black shoes; gold watch on his left wrist. Poses include arms crossed.
